NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author pushed two more commits: one raising the max-width to 15em and one touching font-weight and adding an end-of-file newline. They also updated the screenshots and added a comparison with the other open PRs in the description.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Description now compares the approach with #39049, #39829 and #39768. |
| ✅  | Before/after screenshots now use a genuinely long name, and the limit is 15em instead of 150px. |
| ❌  | The two new commits ("fix: …", "css(reactions): …") are fixes that were not squashed into the original commit, so the history breaks commit discipline. |
| ⚠️  | The last commit includes font-weight and formatting changes that aren't part of this fix (+59/-29 for a small CSS change). |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to clean up the commits.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the screenshots and the description! Before this can be reviewed, please squash the "fix:" and "css(reactions):" commits into the main commit, and drop the unrelated font-weight and formatting changes. See our [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html).
```
